evidence: environment/assets/seed_data.json and solution/app/seed/seed_data.json are byte-identical (sha256 b256f85e...bf8) and parse. A python -B referential script confirmed: 18 unique message ids K-1..K-18; every author is a seeded account that can see its matter (clients only author in their own matter; walled dev authors nothing in M-12); every parent exists earlier in the same matter; each matter's client has role client, walled lists hold only staff, timer_days values are in timer_options_days; every read_up_to pointer resolves to a message in that matter for a user who can see it (dev has no M-12 entry, paul only M-12); all timestamps and version timestamps are <= the 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z clock; messages within each matter are chronologically sorted. Two messages (M-11 K-1 at 05-01, K-10 at exactly 7 days) are already past the 7-day timer at import; this is a deliberate, publicly specified retention fixture (walls-and-retention.md 'a message sent exactly seven days ago ... is already gone') graded consistently at functional judge.toml:119-126, with the K-14 reply surviving under a placeholder as conversations.md/walls-and-retention.md require, so it is not an orphan defect. People are synthetic (Harriet Rowe, Dev Anand, Sian Lloyd, Gwen Pryce, Paul Marsh) on the reserved .test TLD; 'Fenwick Mills' is fictional business text; no phone, address, DOB, or secret. The seed carries no credentials (password123 appears only in /instructions and app_context, which the profile/annotation allows). The only markup is K-16 'Schedule 2 ... clause 4 ... rent' plus K-12 '*Schedule 4*': benign formatting fixtures required by conversations.md 'Formatting' and checked at functional judge.toml:191; no script, event handler, javascript: URL, or prompt-injection text to an LLM judge. Weak/alternative app probes: an app that hard-deletes expired K-1 without a tombstone would orphan K-14, but the public brief requires the placeholder, so that is a submission defect, not a seed inconsistency; a conforming app that escapes K-16 literally passes line 191. No defect found.
